column1: # Earshot label table. One row per sound prefab, or a prefix with a trailing *.
# category: Boss Raid Enemy Wildlife World Ambient Self, or - to use the game's own caption type
# action:   a key in translations/<Language>.txt, or @vanilla (the game's own action word)
# flags:    idle (throttled chatter), mute (never caption), near (near tag even if not a threat)
# Prefab names with a space are written with _ : "sfx_distant thunder" -> sfx_distant_thunder.
# Creature loops (sounds attached to the creature itself) use creature:<prefab>.
# Sounds with no row still get captioned from the game's own caption tokens when those are clean.
# --- Enemies: sounds the game leaves uncaptioned ---
# The Bear runs on the Lox's footsteps (it never plays sfx_bear_footstep), so name the walker.
# --- Attack wind-ups the game leaves uncaptioned: the warning before the hit ---
# The game labels the plain Greydwarf idle "Greydwarf Brute growling".
# Attached to the Boar's walking footstep, labelled as a dying seal.
# The game's generic random ambience (birds, wind gusts): no identifiable source.
# The game labels skeleton idles and deaths "attacking".
# The Bear's own caption key ($enemy_bear) has no text; its creature name is $enemy_bjorn.
# Boar attacks are typed as wildlife by the game; they are a threat.
# The Stone Golem's second attack carries an asset path as its caption, and its main attack and idle
# Threats the game types as Misc.
# Captions naming a creature key with no text: Fader's fire-breath wind-up says $enemy_father.
# Vile and Writhan sounds are captioned as the Bear ($enemy_bear, no text).
# Deep North: the game's captions use keys with no text ($sfx_frozenking, $sfx_moose, ...).
# sfx_tree_fall is the tree coming down. sfx_tree_fall_hit is a log's impact sound: it plays every time a
# log knocks into something (each axe hit, rolling, settling when an area loads), not when a tree falls.
# --- Hits and blocks: the sound of your own attacks landing ---
# --- Ambient: off by default (constant background inside a base) ---
